versions.name: Kubernetes apply
versions.description: Apply a manifest from the workspace to a Kubernetes cluster using kubectl on the Runner host, with the cluster credential passed as a masked secret.
versions.description_zh: 使用 Runner 宿主机上的 kubectl，将 workspace 中的清单应用到 Kubernetes 集群——集群凭证以掩码 secret 传入。
versions.author: buz maintainers
